name: cjk-aware-word-wrap
title: CJK-aware word wrap in measure.py
description: Unspaced CJK text is tokenised as one oversized word, so _word_break flushes the prefix line (jarvis ❯ echo separated from content). Make _tokenise_words CJK-aware per UAX #14 subset: break between CJK clusters, keep latin words atomic, kinsoku for CJK punctuation.
